entries.name: UDP_BroadcastLobbyPacket
entries.comment: Broadcasts 64-byte buf at 0x0045D480 to all peers (peerID=0xFFFF). Args: a0=usr_val0, a1=usr_byte, a2=usr_val1. Calls UDPSendRaw with t1=6.

entries.name: UDPSendRaw
entries.comment: Raw UDP send. a0=pktBuf, a1=size, a2=socket, a3=peerID (0xFFFF=broadcast), t0=srcParam, t1=msgType, t2=extraData, t3=flags. Calls 0x00628D48 (libnetb send).

entries.name: libnetb_SendTo
entries.comment: libnetb sendto wrapper — actual network I/O. Called by UDPSendRaw. High-addr = IOP/libnetb export thunk.

entries.name: FindObjectByName
entries.comment: Hashtable lookup by name string. a0=name_str. Returns object ptr or NULL. Used by packet senders to resolve UI var recipients (e.g. ChatRecipient). List head at 0x004A1BC4.

entries.name: UDPSend_Chat
entries.comment: Builds and sends UDP chat packet. Resolves ChatRecipient UI var (0x0041DB28) for peer ID. Allocates 6-byte packet, writes type+recipient into header, calls UDP_SendToPeer.

entries.name: gLobbyUDPPacketBuf
entries.comment: Shared 64-byte UDP P2P lobby packet buffer. All send functions write packet payload here before calling UDPSendRaw. Byte[0] = init flag, Byte[1] = peer count.

entries.name: gPeerSocketHandle
entries.comment: UDP P2P session socket/connection handle. Passed as a2 to UDPSendRaw. Points to the active peer connection struct.

entries.name: UDP_LobbyPacketProcessor
entries.comment: Main UDP lobby packet processor (2560 bytes). Processes outbound queue, checks Medius connection via 0x00321950, filters loopback IPs (7F000000), dispatches to type-1/type-2 handlers. Calls UDPSendRaw.

entries.name: UDP_InboundPacketProcessor
entries.comment: Secondary UDP packet processor (1888 bytes). Processes inbound packets from peers. Checks gPeerCount (0x0045D481), calls 0x002C4C40. Handles ping/packet-loss calc with FP (val*0.001).

entries.name: UDP_RouteIncomingByPeerID
entries.comment: Route incoming packet by sender peer ID (2352 bytes). a2=peerID. Checks peerID against player slot IDs at 0x0044DC78-0x0044DCB0 and 0xFFFF/0xFFFE. Triages to join/disconnect handlers.

entries.name: Lobby_RefreshPeerState
entries.comment: Checks gPeerCount (0x0045D481), calls UDP_GetPeerByBuffer, Lobby_SyncPeerData (0x002C5960), and UDP_BroadcastLobbyState (0x00307E80). Refreshes peer session state after network event.

entries.name: Lobby_UpdateLoop
entries.comment: Main lobby state update loop. Called with session object ptr after peer count changes. Updates lobby timers, syncs state to peers, processes join/leave queue.

entries.name: Lobby_OnPeerCountChange
entries.comment: Called from UDP_OnPlayerSessionChange when peer count changes. a0=TeamId. Notifies lobby system of peer join/leave and triggers state sync.

entries.name: UDP_GetPeerByBuffer
entries.comment: Gets peer connection record from packet buffer at gLobbyUDPPacketBuf (0x0045D480). Returns peer context ptr used by Lobby_RefreshPeerState.

entries.name: UDP_GetSocketForPeer
entries.comment: Returns socket struct for a given peer address. Calls UDP_EnumPeerSockets (0x0062A108). a0=peerAddr. Used before UDPSendRaw to get the socket handle.

entries.name: UDP_SendToPeer
entries.comment: Loads peer socket via UDP_GetSocketForPeer, dispatches by peer ID: 0xFFFF=broadcast-all, 0xFFFE=host-relay, 0xFFFD=?, specific=targeted send. Calls UDPSendRaw.

entries.name: UDP_SendToSpecificPeer
entries.comment: Targeted UDP send variant. Uses UDP_ProcessPeerPacket_A (0x0032AAD0) and UDP_ProcessPeerPacket_B (0x0032AA90) to route to specific peer rather than broadcast.

entries.name: UDP_BroadcastToPeers
entries.comment: Iterates all peers and sends UDP packet to each. Called from UDPSend_Chat when peerID=0xFFFF. Loops over peer ID table at 0x0044DC78 (8 entries, stride 8).

entries.name: UDP_GetPktBuf_ConnState
entries.comment: State accessor stub (64 bytes). Returns 0x0044D800 if connected state, else 0x0044D760. Selects between two packet buffer regions based on current connection state.

entries.name: UDP_GetPktBuf_ConnState2
entries.comment: Second state accessor stub. Returns 0x0044D7F0 if connected, else 0x0044D750. Paired with UDP_GetPktBuf_ConnState for alternate buffer region selection.

entries.name: UDP_OnPlayerSessionChange
entries.comment: Stores session byte in gLocalPlayerSessionByte (0x0044DCF8), then calls Lobby_OnPeerCountChange, Lobby_UpdateLoop, Lobby_RefreshPeerState. Triggered on player session state change.

entries.name: Lobby_SyncPeerData
entries.comment: Syncs peer data to all connected peers after state change. Called from Lobby_RefreshPeerState. Writes peer table entries and broadcasts updated lobby state.

entries.name: UDP_EnumPeerSockets
entries.comment: libnetb/sceNet peer socket enumeration. Called by UDP_GetSocketForPeer to retrieve the socket struct for a peer connection. Returns ptr to peer socket record. High-addr = IOP/libnetb export thunk.

entries.name: UDP_BroadcastLobbyState
entries.comment: Broadcasts updated lobby state to all peers. Called from Lobby_RefreshPeerState with gLobbyStateCounter (0x00452730) and peerID=0xFFFF.

entries.name: gPlayerPeerID_table
entries.comment: Player peer ID table. 8 entries, 8-byte stride: [0]=0x0044DC78, [1]=0x0044DC80 ... [7]=0x0044DCB0. Each entry is a 16-bit peer ID for that player slot. Iterated by UDP_BroadcastToPeers.

entries.name: gLocalPlayerSessionByte
entries.comment: Local player session byte. Written by UDP_OnPlayerSessionChange. Used to track if local player is spectator vs active player in the P2P lobby.

entries.name: gLobbySessionPtr
entries.comment: Pointer to the active lobby session object. Object layout: +0xC0=vtable, +0xC8=field32, +0xE4=pktCounter, +0xF9=flag, +0x10C=innerObjPtr, +0x118/+0x119=team bytes, +0x0E4=packet counter.

entries.name: gObjectNameHashList
entries.comment: Head of linked list used by FindObjectByName hashtable. Stores named UI variable objects (e.g., ChatRecipient, other game UI vars). Traversed by 0x0036F520.

entries.name: gLobbyStateCounter
entries.comment: Lobby state version counter. Passed to UDP_BroadcastLobbyState. Zero when not in a lobby. Incremented on lobby state changes to detect stale/updated state across peers.

entries.name: STR_PKT_Reject
entries.comment: UDP packet type name string. Type index 0. Used in packet type dispatch table.

entries.name: STR_PKT_Message
entries.comment: UDP packet type name string. Type index 1.

entries.name: STR_PKT_Chat
entries.comment: UDP packet type name string. Type index 2.

entries.name: STR_PKT_WeaponPickup
entries.comment: UDP pkt type str. Index 3. "Wep PU" = Weapon Pickup.

entries.name: STR_PKT_AmmoPickup
entries.comment: UDP pkt type str. Index 4. "Wep Ammo PU" = Weapon Ammo Pickup.

entries.name: STR_PKT_PickupReq
entries.comment: UDP pkt type str. Index 5. "PU May I" = Pickup Request (ask host permission).

entries.name: STR_PKT_PickupOK
entries.comment: UDP pkt type str. Index 6. "PU OK" = Pickup Approved by host.

entries.name: STR_PKT_ClimbAsk
entries.comment: UDP pkt type str. Index 7. "ClimbAsk" = request to climb an object/ladder.

entries.name: STR_PKT_ClimbOK
entries.comment: UDP pkt type str. Index 8. "ClimbOK" = climb request approved.

entries.name: STR_PKT_Names
entries.comment: UDP pkt type str. Index 9. "Names" = Player name sync packet.

entries.name: STR_PKT_Voter
entries.comment: UDP pkt type str. Index 10. "Voter" = host votes to kick/change game option.

entries.name: STR_PKT_SpecVote
entries.comment: UDP pkt type str. Index 11. "Spec Vote" = spectator vote packet.

entries.name: STR_PKT_TeamSwitch
entries.comment: UDP pkt type str. Index 12. "Team Switch" = player team switch request/notify.

entries.name: STR_PKT_AllSwitch
entries.comment: UDP pkt type str. Index 13. "All Switch" = all-team/all-player switch broadcast.

entries.name: STR_PKT_Bomb
entries.comment: UDP pkt type str. Index 14. "Bomb" = bomb plant/defuse/explode event.

entries.name: STR_PKT_Alert
entries.comment: UDP pkt type str. Index 15. "Alert" = server/host alert broadcast to peers.

entries.name: STR_PKT_GameSignal
entries.comment: UDP pkt type str. Index 16. "Game Signal" = generic game-state signal (round end, start, etc).

entries.name: STR_ERR_PasswordError
entries.comment: Reject reason string. "Password Error" — sent in STR_PKT_Reject payload when password mismatch.

entries.name: STR_ERR_TooManySpecs
entries.comment: Reject reason string. "Too many spectators" — sent in STR_PKT_Reject when spectator slots full.

entries.name: STR_ERR_TooManyPlayers
entries.comment: Reject reason string. "Too many players" — player slots full.

entries.name: STR_ERR_ClosedClanGame
entries.comment: Reject reason string. "Closed clan game" — non-clan member tried to join a clan-locked game.

entries.name: STR_ERR_TotallyUnknown
entries.comment: Reject reason string. "Totally unknown error" — catch-all fallback reject reason.

entries.name: gConnectionCounter1
entries.comment: Peer connection counter 1. Incremented on peer connect events. Paired with gConnectionCounter2 at 0x0044DD18.

entries.name: gConnectionCounter2
entries.comment: Peer connection counter 2. Second connect event counter. Paired with gConnectionCounter1 at 0x0044DD08.

entries.name: gLocalIPMask
entries.comment: Local IP loopback mask. Used by UDP_LobbyPacketProcessor to filter own packets. Checked: srcIP & 0x7F0000FE == gLocalIPMask.
